verdict.rationale: Mercury ships an official agent skill, `mercury-detect-anomaly`, in its mercury-skills repo; it runs through the Mercury CLI, so a user's own AI agent can scan transactions for anomalies. Transaction webhooks could trigger such a scan, and approval policies and gated disbursements can route payments for manual review. However, the evidence shows no built-in AI that automatically flags anomalous or out-of-policy transactions; flagging depends on the user wiring up their own agent, and the policy-review features are rule-based, not AI. Missing for 10: native automatic AI anomaly flagging, AI detection of out-of-policy spend tied to spend controls, documentation of what the detect-anomaly skill actually checks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
